goal: Choose one primary job: acquisition, education, objection handling or offer conversion
awareness: Replace with problem-aware, solution-aware or product-aware
angle: Replace with one evidenced selling idea
product_category: State what the product actually is
buyer_desire: What does this buyer want beyond owning the product?
concept_family: Choose a message/visual format appropriate to this idea
scene: Describe a genuinely distinct scene; the identity photo does not lock the scene
creative_hypothesis: Why this message and visual should motivate this buyer to click
primary_text: Write the caption/primary ad copy that supports the image
headline: Replace with exact headline
art_direction: Specify photography, lighting, background, palette and typography
composition: Specify focal point, product position, copy hierarchy and whitespace
audience_insight: Replace with the buyer's specific situation, belief or objection
core_promise: Replace with one supportable reason to care
objection: Replace with the one objection this concept addresses
proof_or_reason: Replace with sourced evidence or an honest practical reason
offer_framing: Replace with approved offer value, or explain why this indirect frame does not pitch an offer
curiosity_payoff: Replace with the actual insight or immediate information promised by the hook
hook_selection_reason: Replace with why the chosen headline is stronger for this buyer and route

design_spec.grid: Replace with alignment anchors, margins and composition grid
design_spec.typography: Replace with type character, family, weights, scale and line-wrap direction
design_spec.spacing: Replace with spacing rhythm and optical adjustments
design_spec.photo_direction: Replace with lighting, crop, texture and human realism
design_spec.product_integration: Replace with scale, perspective, shadow and copy/image relationship
design_spec.reference_analysis: Replace with observations from the actual reference and brand adaptation
design_spec.carousel_continuity: Replace with series rules and slide job, or an authored standalone explanation
